visual_requirements.description: adult Roman hunt goddess, one head two arms two legs, fully opaque dark green wool hunting tunic and leather bracers, plain bow and quiver
Physical archery and hunt, no magic beams; moonlight is environmental light reflecting lunar domain
grove at Aricia beside Lake Nemi, deer in deep background

source_claims.quote: However, she is best known as the goddess of the hunt, with her sacred animal being the deer.

statement.id: Diana paling dikenal sebagai dewi perburuan dengan rusa sebagai hewan sucinya.
statement.en: Diana is best known as a hunt goddess, with the deer as her sacred animal.

source_claims.quote: In most works of Roman art, Diana is depicted armed with a bow and quiver of arrows

statement.id: Seni Romawi sering menggambarkan Diana membawa busur dan tabung panah.
statement.en: Roman art commonly portrays Diana with a bow and quiver.

source_claims.quote: according to most accounts, her skill with the bow unquestionably equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian besar riwayat, keterampilan Diana memanah setara dengan saudara kembarnya, Apollo.
statement.en: According to most accounts, Diana's skill with the bow equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

source_claims.quote: She is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, and presides over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana pada dasarnya dewi bulan dan cahaya, yang menguasai hutan, dataran, air, perburuan, dan perang.
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, Diana is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, presiding over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

source_claims.quote: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia (whence her title of Nemorensis) near the modern lake of Nemi. Here she was worshipped side by side with a male deity Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

statement.id: Tempat sucinya yang paling termasyhur ada di hutan kecil di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi (maka gelar Nemorensis); di sana ia dipuja bersama dewa Virbius, dewa hutan dan perburuan.
statement.en: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia near Lake Nemi (hence her title Nemorensis), where she was worshipped alongside Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
Distinct facial age and morphology are editorial choices to avoid repetitive deity faces.
